name: Astral Ltd
about: Astral Poly Technik Ltd was established in 1996, with the aim to manufacture pro-India plumbing and drainage systems in the country. The company is into manufacturing of Pipes, water tanks, bathware, specialised valves, paints, adhesives and sealants, infrastructure solutions, specialised fittings and construction chemicals. [1]

flags.text: Revenue compounded 15.6% a year over 5 years but profit only 5.6%: growth is getting less profitable

business.what: Astral Limited manufactures and sells plumbing and drainage systems, adhesives, paints, and specialty chemicals. It generates revenue through the sale of these products across domestic and international markets.

segments.name: Plumbing
segments.comment: Delivered 10.1% growth despite weak industry demand, supported by new plant decentralization.

segments.name: Adhesive India
segments.comment: Achieved robust 24.9% growth with strong response in rural and online channels.

segments.name: Adhesive U.K.
segments.comment: Returned to growth path with 26% increase and improved EBITDA margins.

segments.name: Paint
segments.comment: Recorded historic high growth of 48.7% and reached EBITDA breakeven point.

segments.name: DSS (Specialty Chemicals)
segments.comment: Newly acquired business delivered immediate revenue and 12.9% EBITDA margin.

ledger.promise: Full year FY26 revenue growth of 20%
ledger.quote: This year we have given a guidance of 20% growth for the full year and we are going to achieve it as per the guidance given by us.
ledger.actual: FY26 revenue was Rs 6,569 crore versus Rs 5,832 crore in FY25, achieving 12.63% growth and missing the 20% target.

ledger.promise: EBITDA margin baseline run rate of 15% to 16%
ledger.quote: EBITDA margin is also very stable and moving in the range of 15% to 16% continuously. We are confident that this run rate will continue in coming fiscals.
ledger.actual: FY26 EBITDA margin was 16.2%, but dropped to 14.6% in Q1 FY27 and 13.1% in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: CPVC plant installation and commissioning by September 2026 / Q4 FY27
ledger.quote: we will be finishing the installation of machinery and construction of the CPVC plant by next year, by September 2026
ledger.actual: Timeline shifted in Q1 FY27 call to completing construction by December 2026 end and commercial production in Q4 FY27.

ledger.promise: Bathware business 20%-25% CAGR over next 4-5 years
ledger.quote: Bathware we will aim to grow at about 20%-25% for the next 5 years.
ledger.actual: Standalone Bathware segment revenue is not reported in financial filings.

ledger.promise: UK business EBITDA margin of double digit / 8-10% plus
ledger.quote: we are confident that we will come back to our original double digit kind of EBITDA margin in the next year.
ledger.actual: UK business segment EBITDA margins are not disclosed in reported financials.

ledger.quote: our PEX line is one of the most advanced lines in India. we just got the machines in last week and uh by September we should be up and running.
ledger.actual: Reported numbers do not break out PEX volumes or plant commissioning completion status.

ledger.promise: Plumbing business EBITDA margin of 16% to 18% in FY27
ledger.quote: Plumbing plumbing margin will be between 16 to 18%. So that whatever margin guidance we've been given we'll follow the same guidance for this year.
ledger.actual: FY27 is ongoing; consolidated EBITDA margin was 14.6% in Q1 FY27 and 13.1% in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Plumbing top-line value growth of more than 20% in FY27
ledger.quote: And if that is the case, our value growth for the full year will be more than 20%, in top line.
ledger.actual: Consolidated revenue grew 26.1% YoY in Q2 FY27 to Rs 1,988 crore.

ledger.promise: Total FY27 capex spend of INR 300 to 350 crore
ledger.quote: I think we have said, 300 kind of level, 300 to 350 level kind of level will be there.
ledger.actual: Capital WIP increased to Rs 210 crore in FY27; full-year cash flow disclosures are pending.

current_guidance.quote: As we guided in last call that we will be closing full year with 20%, 25% kind of growth. But with this kind of number in Q1, we are confident that we will be definitely crossing the guided number.
gives us the confidence that what we have given the guidance of double-digit growth

So we will be definitely going to be in the range of 16% to 18%.
I think we have said, 300 kind of level, 300 to 350 level kind of level will be there.
But we are happy that we can deliver this 20%, 25% CAGR in Bathware business over the coming 4, 5 years.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Management missed its full-year FY26 revenue growth guidance of 20% by delivering 12.63%, and EBITDA margins in recent quarters (14.6% in Q1 FY27 and 13.1% in Q2 FY27) fell below promised ranges. However, top-line re-acceleration in Q2 FY27 (26.1% YoY growth) and strong FY26 operating cash flow (Rs 1,117 crore) demonstrate underlying operational strength.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reiterated confident guidance of 20% full year revenue growth in FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 revenue came in at Rs 6,569 crore compared to Rs 5,832 crore in FY25, delivering 12.63% growth.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management guided that EBITDA margins would remain stable continuously in the 15% to 16% range.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margin dropped to 14.6% in Q1 FY27 and further compressed to 13.1% in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management asserted that raw material softening and lower overall costs in Q2 FY27 would positively impact margins.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated EBITDA margin weakened from 14.6% in Q1 FY27 to 13.1% in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management expected strong sales acceleration in FY27, targeting >20% plumbing top-line value growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue grew 26.1% YoY to Rs 1,988 crore from Rs 1,577 crore in Q2 FY26.

bull.point: Top-line growth re-accelerated sharply in Q2 FY27.
bull.evidence: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 26.1% YoY to Rs 1,988 crore from Rs 1,577 crore in Q2 FY26, supporting management's >20% value growth target.

bull.point: Strong operating cash flow generation supports expansion.
bull.evidence: Cash flow from operations expanded to Rs 1,117 crore in FY26 while debt remained modest at Rs 250 crore.
Capital WIP increased to Rs 210 crore in FY27 as the CPVC resin plant moves toward Q4 FY27 completion.

bear.point: Missed full-year revenue growth guidance for FY26.
bear.evidence: FY26 revenue grew 12.63% to Rs 6,569 crore, failing to reach the guided 20% growth target.

bear.point: Margin compression significantly below guided baseline range.
bear.evidence: EBITDA margin fell to 13.1% in Q2 FY27, well below management's guided baseline of 15% to 16%.

bear.point: CPVC plant project timeline experienced delays.
bear.evidence: CPVC plant completion target moved from September 2026 to December 2026 end construction completion with trials in Q4 FY27.
